recommended_alternative.metric: Per-task comparison of reported task-success means
recommended_alternative.definition: x = SIMPLER mean, y = World-Gymnast mean; annotation = y minus x in percentage points
recommended_alternative.plot: Equal-axis 0–100% plane with y=x parity diagonal, four labeled task points, and descriptive percentage-point differences.
recommended_alternative.note: The x/y marginal SE bars may be shown separately. No joint confidence region or uncertainty on y-x can be inferred without assumptions absent from the workbook. Four task points do not justify correlation or broad superiority claims.
